_README: THE RESEARCH PLAN: the only source for the public phases, gates, dates and deadlines of Psyche's current research line, spiking cognitive maps (D-031).
README.md, docs/research/, the wiki and the docs site render from it: python3 tools/publish/render_plan.py --write.
Public granularity only. Criteria, thresholds, experiment ids, venues and funding live in the private companion,
keyed by these ids. tools/publish/core.py validates this file against a key allowlist, so no other field can exist.
A date that differs from its baseline_date needs a changelog entry. Status words are lowercase on purpose.

line.title: Cognitive Map Formation and Energy Efficiency in Spiking Neural Networks with Local Plasticity

phases.title: Environments, battery and baselines
outputs: baseline agents reproduced against their published behaviour

phases.title: Spiking model
outputs: a spiking agent that learns with local plasticity, running on the battery

phases.title: Scaling, ablations and the energy estimate
Public release
outputs: the battery and the energy estimate, released after submission
the model, released after the review decision

gates.title: Novelty
gates.question: Is this line's combination of aims new, or is its difference from the closest published work written down and defensible?
gates.if_missed: Reposition the contribution and record the decision before work continues.

gates.title: Comparisons
gates.question: Do the environments, the battery and the baseline agents run, and do the baselines reproduce the behaviour their papers report?
gates.if_missed: Extend briefly, then narrow the baseline set to the strongest published reference.

gates.title: Spiking model
gates.question: Does the spiking model meet its pre-registered behavioural criteria on the battery?
gates.if_missed: Shift the submission target; the work proceeds on the safe base and the failure analysis.

gates.title: Paper
gates.date_rule: one week before the submission deadline
gates.question: Are all figures, the multi-seed results and the ablations in, and have external readers' comments been worked in?
gates.if_missed: A workshop paper and a preprint; a later main-track venue.

deadlines.title: Paper submission to a major peer-reviewed ML venue

layers.title: Safe base
layers.summary: Environments, the battery, baseline comparisons, analysis and the report. The line stands on this even if the spiking model does not work.

layers.title: Main goal
layers.summary: The spiking model with local plasticity, evaluated on the battery, with an analytic estimate of its synaptic operations.

layers.title: Failure analysis
layers.summary: If the main goal falls short, a documented account of where and why, kept as a result in its own right.
